args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living / Covey & Lark
args.body:
Hi June,

Flagging a label mix-up on the Pellow Home Living account (PHL):

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals", so the old name is still showing up in reporting.
- Could you check whether the old name needs updating in the deal-desk records and anywhere else it is still used?

Thanks,
Sofia
